$comment: selection-policy/1 (contract-map.md, T15a; plan Sections 5.9, 5.13; K16, K18): what is fixed before a selection. K16's gates and objective are the user's, so role is a constant and only an artificial policy can be read until K16 is decided and T15b widens it. Read through contracts/sidecar_reader.py, not an artifact type.

role.$comment: K16: a fixture's values test rules only, and say so

granularity.$comment: Section 5.11, K16: a per-event policy is a separate recipe

target.$comment: SEL01: an irreplaceable goal; with none, this document is refused and nothing is selected

quality_contract.$comment: null: no quality gate is fixed, so no objective is either (Section 5.9 item 3). What a contract holds is K16's; here it names the checks evidence must cover (Section 8.4 check 6)

objective.$comment: Section 5.14, DS1: the one objective a witness states. null: not fixed, so only the declared baseline can be chosen

shared_overhead.$comment: Section 5.14: inspection and selection overhead shared by all candidates. DS1 fixes it at 0, a value real comparisons cannot reuse

baseline.$comment: Section 5.9 item 4, K16: the predeclared conservative baseline, a recipe_id of the index, or null. It is the declared fallback of SEL08 and Section 5.13

sample_roles.$comment: Section 5.10, SEL07: selection may read development, calibration and selection data, never confirmation data

sample_groups.$comment: Sections 5.10, 5.13; K08: groups by common origin, the data groups a replay must name
